notes.title: Chaos Kart Update v1.6.5
notes.notes:
CK Changelist for version 1.6.5
*********************************

* Add music converted from mp3 to wav

* Add pre race music

* Add countdown sounds

* Add end-race jingle

* Change beach map music to the new track

* Move all sound trigger code to the game mode

* Change lightmass importance volume on menu map

* Add new minimap, and minimap associated components to map and player

* Edit beach track map texture to suit the minimap maths

* Edit Minimap background material to support lower opacity  

* Change the drift Barrier effect to the new Niagara System asset

* UI button hover sound changed to the new version

* Fix incorrect map placement 

* Add new minimap to multiplayer overlay

* Put correct HUD icon textures for abilities

* Reduce countdown time to 3

* Fix players able to attack briefly on spawn in at match start

* Add callback to have menu music loop

* Add proper callback to have race music loop in-game

* Stop drift effect particles when on rough terrain

* Fix incorrect position numbers when going backwards across the finish line
  and improve race position system
